narrative: Material PL1__M3E92184 shows highly volatile working-day demand (CV=0.82) with ~17% zero-demand days and an insignificant upward trend. Lead times are unstable (CV=0.69), dominated by transport variability. The (r,Q) continuous-review policy was selected to react promptly to inventory drawdowns under this demand-lead-time uncertainty profile. The analytically derived safety stock of 3,414 units is 17% lower than the current SAP baseline of 4,125, while the recommended safety lead time of 2.26 days replaces the overstated SAP value of 3.8 days.

research_insights.selection_rationale: High demand volatility (CV=0.82) combined with unstable lead times (CV=0.69) makes continuous review the appropriate choice; it triggers replenishment precisely when inventory hits the reorder point, minimizing stockout exposure without the over-stocking inherent in a fixed periodic review interval.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Capacity utilization at 63.9% (14,422 of 22,553 units); no capacity constraint binds and there is 8,131 units of headroom. No service or cost risk from the storage cap.
